tessa: filing quick notes from onboarding run for aurora-24b-int4. we see a reproducible 'bitswap' pattern after heavy prepend sequences (~40k tokens) where odd/even lanes seem swapped and KV reads pull stale entries.

omar: can you paste repro and a tiny log snippet?

tessa: repro command below. this is on dedicated-staging pool with quant-table=newpack.

```
./eval_tool --model aurora-24b-int4 --prompt tests/long/repeat_headers_5000.txt --max-tokens 65000 --quant-table newpack --kv-dump --seed 99
```

build-bot: quick metrics posted -> p50 3.8ms p95 11.4ms, token-integrity-fails 0.9% (baseline 0.01%)

frank: log tail shows odd index math, looks like underflow when pack boundary crosses 98304

```
[2026-10-05T21:04:12Z] kv: shard=0 write_idx=98302 expected=98303 actual=98301
[2026-10-05T21:04:12Z] rope: stored_phase=49151 computed_phase=49149
[2026-10-05T21:04:12Z] integrity: detected_bitswap lane_pair=(2,3) token_id=42111 pos=40212
```

anya: interesting, 98304 = 96k boundary. pack interleave for "newpack" uses 3-word stride, kernel change in packer might be producing misaligned lane offsets.

omar: try fallback to --quant-table=legacy_pack and set KV_PREFETCH=adaptive to see effect. also try ENV ROPE_SCALE=1.0 -> 0.5 to test phase sensitivity.

(tessa runs quick A/B)

tessa: results: legacy_pack + KV_PREFETCH=adaptive drops bitswap to 0.03% but still some tail mismatches beyond 60k tokens. ROPE_SCALE=0.5 reduces mismatches but increases perplexity from 15.4 -> 17.1. uploading traces to s3://redwood-evals/aurora24b/int4/bitswap/1869990000/

frank: can you include kv-dump diffs? curious if the stale entries are coming from write_idx jumping backwards or from read-index computation.

(tessa): included kv-dump and lane-mapping trace. quick diff shows write_idx sometimes increments by -2 in a single step on wrap. snippet:
```
write_idx seq: ... 98300, 98301, 98303, 98305, 2, 3 ...
```

omar: that looks like an overflow handling bug in the index increment routine when pack-order uses modulo 98304 math. maybe int16 overflow + shift. I'll bisect the packer commits around the newpack landing. assigning to @omar to run kernel-level rollback and run unit test reproducer.

build-bot: deploy-bot triggered: canary aurora-24b-int4 -> staging-pool-9 at 2026-10-05T21:06:00Z

anya: suggestion: add an integration test that primes >80k tokens with randomized header lengths and checks sequential KV checksum after each 1k writes. will open PR for tester/longprefill/test_bitswap_guard.py

omar: also try running with ROPE_MODE=legacy and with packing parity fix patch (will try locally). will post commit IDs once bisect narrows it down.

(tessa): thanks — keeping the failure seeds in the artifact bundle and will rerun when you post the rollback PR. :thumbsup:
